problem_text:
A logistics company needs to select packages to load onto a cargo plane. Available packages are:
* Package 1: weight 20 tons, revenue $121K
* Package 2: weight 3 tons, revenue $295K
* Package 3: weight 28 tons, revenue $219K
* Package 4: weight 35 tons, revenue $183K
* Package 5: weight 14 tons, revenue $76K
* Package 6: weight 19 tons, revenue $54K
* Package 7: weight 9 tons, revenue $40K
* Package 8: weight 22 tons, revenue $35K
* Package 9: weight 9 tons, revenue $44K
* Package 10: weight 34 tons, revenue $66K
* Package 11: weight 8 tons, revenue $34K
* Package 12: weight 8 tons, revenue $85K
* Package 13: weight 25 tons, revenue $166K
* Package 14: weight 2 tons, revenue $235K
* Package 15: weight 7 tons, revenue $107K
* Package 16: weight 39 tons, revenue $270K
* Package 17: weight 36 tons, revenue $16K
* Package 18: weight 15 tons, revenue $94K
* Package 19: weight 1 ton, revenue $234K
* Package 20: weight 17 tons, revenue $158K
* Package 21: weight 39 tons, revenue $102K
* Package 22: weight 33 tons, revenue $211K
* Package 23: weight 21 tons, revenue $63K
* Package 24: weight 11 tons, revenue $71K
* Package 25: weight 36 tons, revenue $84K
* Package 26: weight 31 tons, revenue $89K
* Package 27: weight 1 ton, revenue $27K
* Package 28: weight 20 tons, revenue $121K

The aircraft has a maximum payload capacity of 380 tons. Choose the package combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each package must be either fully accepted or rejected.
